$comment: Spawn audit (spec K.4, INV-03): every call site in src/ and apps/ that starts a process or runs code outside the realm, per file and kind, with an owner and a reason.
supervisor: Volt core starts it as the monitor (sandbox supervisor, stdio service, the app's own hosts and helpers); nothing an agent wrote decides what runs.
user-action: it runs for the user's own action (their terminals, tasks, installs, extensions, debug sessions).
build-only: build, release and developer tooling that never ships in the app.
A process Volt starts for a chat goes through the stdio service with the chat's ExecContext. Check with: node build/volt/ci/spawnAudit.mjs

sites.why: Mobile build cache tooling; never shipped.
Builds the mobile diff bundle at build time.
Fast mobile rebuilds for developers.
Builds the mobile Monaco bundle at build time.
Mobile release builds in CI.
Developer runner for simulators and Metro.
The relay runner asks each agent CLI for its version (a fixed argument list) to report what it can run.
The relay runner starts a cloud task's agent CLI with an allow-listed environment (runnerAgentEnv) and git for its checkout; the runner's container is the boundary (see agents.mjs).
Publishes the volt-run npm package.
npx volt-run opens the user's browser on the URL it printed, at the user's command.
npx volt-run unpacks and starts the Volt the user asked it to download.
npx volt-run starts the user's Volt server.
Workbench web workers for Volt's own bundled worker scripts (language features, search); no eval of agent text.
Process helpers for core (tree kill, executable lookup) with fixed commands.
Lists Volt's own process tree (Process Explorer) with fixed ps/wmic commands.
Reads the console code page with a fixed command.
Forks Volt's own node helper processes over IPC.
The volt/code command line the user runs: starts the app and its own helpers.
Developer mode only (running from sources): ripgrep lists the app's own CSS files.
Runs the uninstall hook of an extension the user uninstalls.
Opens the user's external terminal at their request (Open in External Terminal).
Installs or removes the shell command and reads the computer name, at the user's request.
Checks whether WSL is available (wsl.exe --status).
Starts the tunnel CLI when the user turns on Remote Tunnel Access.
Resolves the user's login shell environment once at startup.
The user's terminals: port owner lookup and WSL path translation for them.
The user's terminal shells (node-pty) and their process lookups. A sandboxed chat's terminals reach a PTY only through the stdio service's sandboxed terminal launcher (sandboxPty.ts).
The user's terminal shells (node-pty) and their process lookups. A sandboxed chat's terminals reach a PTY only through the stdio service's sandboxed terminal launcher (sandboxPty.ts).
Lists WSL distributions for the user's terminal profiles.
Applies an update the user accepted.
Restarts into a snap update the user accepted.
Runs the Windows installer of an update the user accepted.
Checks a downloaded installer's Authenticode signature (PowerShell) or a cross-channel app's codesign signature before Volt installs it (S2).
Electron utility processes for Volt's own services (extension host, shared processes).
Reads and writes the Claude login in the Keychain (/usr/bin/security) when the user switches accounts.
Starts Volt's own agent server and checks its state; chats' processes then go through its stdio service.
Registers the agent server with launchd (/bin/launchctl).
Lid-Closed Mode the user turned on: pmset.
Lid-Closed Mode the user turned on: the shared runner for its fixed commands.
Lid-Closed Mode the user turned on: systemd-inhibit.
Lid-Closed Mode the user turned on: powercfg.
Imports cookies from the user's browser when they ask for it (fixed helper commands).
Lists local listening servers (lsof/ps) for the in-app browser.

Looks up dev servers (ps/lsof) and starts the project's start command for an unsandboxed chat's browser primer only; a sandboxed chat never gets it (voltRuntimeService allowStart requires sandbox level off).
Screen capture helper with fixed arguments; refused for sandboxed chats at the host tool gate.
Volt's bundled FFF file finder over the project.
Volt's bundled ripgrep for search tools.
Volt's computer-use helper (built from its bundled source with swiftc, then run); desktop tools are refused for sandboxed chats.
The device hub for simulator streaming: install, start and find it.
simctl/adb/emulator for the device tools; installing or launching an app is refused for sandboxed chats.
Starts volt-fsd, the verified helper that opens files race-free (openat2) for a sandboxed chat's ACP fs/* calls (B-17).
Finds the git executable.
HostGit: the one place Volt's own git runs, with fsmonitor, hooks and ext:: off and the repository layout checked (B-03).
Volt's own git operations; repository-controlled behaviour is HostGit's (B-03, H1).
Verifies a native helper's signature (codesign, Authenticode) and the running app's signer before Volt launches the helper (B-14).
gh and git reads for pull request links and watches.
Reads the battery state (pmset) for host load reports.
The Linux sandbox backend: bubblewrap, its probe and network bridge.
The Windows sandbox backend: starts Microsoft's verified wxc-exec.exe with Volt's request (the workload runs inside its container), and the verified volt-mxc-helper that attests it from outside (C7).
Reads the macOS user cache folder (getconf) for the agent profile.
The supervisor's own run of a prepared, confirmed sandbox (SandboxManager.run).
mkfifo for a sandboxed terminal's control channels (F.6).
Finds the developer tools folder (xcode-select -p) for the sandbox profile.

The macOS sandbox backend: sandbox-exec probe, the kernel log stream, the watchdog and the tree kill, and the verified volt-sandbox-helper (its probe, and the server that spawns workloads with TCC disclaimed and attests them from outside, H7).
Dictation the user turned on: Volt's speech helper, built from its bundled source and run.
Lists processes (ps) to stop what a crashed agent server left behind.
Runs every chat process and command with its ExecContext: a sandboxed chat's only through the sandbox launcher, refused without it (execRefusal).
Reads the agent CLIs' sign-in and usage (Keychain, --version, Codex app server) for the Usage page.
Forks the remote extension host that runs the user's installed extensions.
The server command line the user runs.
ripgrep reads for the web workbench's file views; its git goes through HostGit.
Keychain access for the agent server's secret storage.

The agent server's PTY terminals: a sandboxed chat's start the launcher prepared by the stdio service (prepareSandboxedTerminal) and run only after confirmSandboxedTerminal; others run for unsandboxed chats or the user.
Tunnels (cloudflared, ssh, tailscale) the user set up in Add Device.
Port discovery for forwarded ports (fixed ls/ps commands).
Debug adapters of the user's debug sessions.
Terminal lookups for the user's debug sessions.
The bundled Mermaid renderer's own worker script.
The search service's file listing (find/ripgrep).
The search service's ripgrep file search.
The search service's ripgrep text search.
